title: Pro Athletes' Median Pay: $66,710
description:
Think every pro athlete is a millionaire? Most aren't close.

Sources:
- BLS OEWS via api.bls.gov: Athletes and sports competitors 27-2021, annual median wage, May 2025: https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUN000000000000027202113
- BLS OEWS via api.bls.gov: Athletes and sports competitors, 10th percentile: https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUN000000000000027202111
- BLS OEWS via api.bls.gov: Athletes and sports competitors, 90th percentile: https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUN000000000000027202115
- BLS OEWS via api.bls.gov: Athletes and sports competitors, employment: https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v2/timeseries/data/OEUN000000000000027202101
- Wikipedia: Forbes list of the world's highest-paid athletes: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Forbes_list_of_the_world%27s_highest-paid_athletes

BLS May 2025 (OEWS), athletes and sports competitors (27-2021): 15,070 jobs; median $66,710; 10th percentile $26,500; 90th percentile $742,310. OEWS counts wage-and-salary jobs. Forbes 2026 (cited on Wikipedia): Cristiano Ronaldo earned $300 million, the most of any athlete. Median = half earn more, half earn less. Not financial advice.
